setup.title: Initial setup
setup.intro: First deployment: create the global admin, first agent and first project (each step is skippable).
setup.step1Desc: Create the first global administrator. Required on first deployment; if an admin already exists (e.g. created via CLI), this step auto-forwards to sign in.
setup.step2Desc: Create the first agent entry and issue a one-time registration code and per-agent token. Run the registration command on the build machine.
setup.step3Desc: Create the first project (git/svn). Pipelines can be configured later on the project page.
setup.agentHint: You can skip this: create entries and registration codes later on the Agents page.
setup.credsOneTime: One-time credentials (shown in plain text only once)
setup.credsWarn: Save these now: the token and registration code are shown only once and can never be retrieved later.
setup.cmdNote: Run on the build machine; the registration code is one-time and valid for 24h. Replace 'server' in the command with the real address (defaults: gRPC 50051 / REST 8080).
setup.cliLabel: CLI equivalent (for headless/Docker; running it counts as setup complete):

projects.name: Project name
projects.testConnectionHint: Testing the connection never blocks saving (ADR-0016). The test-connection endpoint is not shipped yet, so the button is disabled; saving does not depend on it.
projects.branchPrefillHint: The git default branch can be prefilled via ls-remote — the ls-remote endpoint is not shipped yet, so enter it manually.
projects.pipelineListDegraded: The pipeline-list endpoint is not shipped yet; pipelines are probed individually by known name (200 = exists, 404 = not configured, other failure = probe failed). Will switch to a real list once the endpoint ships.
projects.membersAdminOnly: Member management requires the project admin role
projects.membersReplaceHint: Saving replaces the whole member set: members not listed are removed (ADR-0014).

overview.degradedNote: Depends on the overview snapshot endpoint (/metrics), not shipped yet
overview.alertsDegradedPrefix: Remaining alerts depend on the overview snapshot endpoint
overview.recentBuildsDegraded: Global recent builds depend on the build-list endpoint, not shipped yet; view per-project builds from the project page.

agents.name: Agent name
agents.customLabelsHint: One key=value per line (AND-matched against job requirements together with system labels)
agents.statesDegraded: Draining / incompatible-version states depend on backend draining-flag and version-window fields (ADR-0017), not yet in the REST contract — not derivable today; wired up once the backend ships the fields.
agents.credentialsOneTime: One-time credentials (shown in plain text only once)
agents.credentialsWarn: Save these now: the token and registration code are shown only once and can never be retrieved later.
agents.cmdNote: Run on the build machine; the registration code is one-time and valid for 24h. Replace 'server' in the command with the real address (defaults: gRPC 50051 / REST 8080).
agents.cleanupHint: Clearing a workspace never touches the cache directory (ADR-0011); each agent's workspace tree is independent.
agents.cleanupUnavailable: The cleanup-command endpoint is not shipped yet (issued over gRPC; no REST cleanup endpoint yet, ADR-0011/0012) — the action area is a placeholder, to be wired up once the endpoint ships.

buildList.empty: No builds yet. Trigger the first build from the editor page.
